name: The Darkest Emptiness
source:
A short novel dealing with the problems of loss of taste for life, existential emptiness and the crisis of psychological assistance in Russia. Will you be able to get out of the rut of destructive thoughts?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2155730/]Steam[/url]]
